item.title: Iran conflict strands tens of thousands of Israelis abroad
item.description: Rescue flights planned for when airspace reopens; travelers advised to stay calm and follow updates; two flydubai flights from Ben Gurion divert to Saudi Arabia The post Iran conflict strands tens of thousands of Israelis abroad appeared first on The Times of Israel.

item.title: ‘We meet again’: Inside the ‘pajama party’ at a north Tel Aviv bomb shelter
item.description: The denizens of this shelter came for safety. But what they found was the impromptu community created when dozens of Israelis are packed together underground, waiting out a war The post ‘We meet again’: Inside the ‘pajama party’ at a north Tel Aviv bomb shelter appeared first on The Times of Israel.

item.title: Top US official: Iran planned to preemptively launch missiles, Trump was forced to act
item.description: Senior admin official claims US offered 'free nuclear fuel forever' but was rebuffed by Iran, which wanted to preserve enrichment ability 'for nuclear bomb'; US official denies being dragged by Israel into war The post Top US official: Iran planned to preemptively launch missiles, Trump was forced to act appeared first on The Times of Israel.

item.title: End of an era as Iran confirms Khamenei is dead; Trump: Justice for Iranians and beyond
item.description: Iranians brave the streets to celebrate; US president urges regime's security personnel to surrender as PM Netanyahu calls on Iran's public to rise up and topple the Islamic regime The post End of an era as Iran confirms Khamenei is dead; Trump: Justice for Iranians and beyond appeared first on The Times of Israel.

item.title: Khamenei set Iran’s direction for decades. Now the public he suppressed has hope
item.description: The 86-year-old supreme leader placed the IRGC at the center of power, and built up a terror network. With so many top aides dead, it is hard to determine who will take his place The post Khamenei set Iran’s direction for decades. Now the public he suppressed has hope appeared first on The Times of Israel.

item.title: Woman killed, dozens injured as Iranian missile strikes Tel Aviv residential block
item.description: Victim is first person killed in Israel in renewed fighting with Iran, as first responders take 27 to hospital, including infant, after heavy damage to two apartment buildings The post Woman killed, dozens injured as Iranian missile strikes Tel Aviv residential block appeared first on The Times of Israel.

item.title: Iran bombards Israel, Gulf, vowing unprecedented response to killing of Khamenei
item.description: Trump threatens to hit Iran with force ‘never seen before’ if attacks escalate * Iranian state TV announces 40 days of mourning for supreme leader, also says Guards chief and top aide Shamkhani killed The post Iran bombards Israel, Gulf, vowing unprecedented response to killing of Khamenei appeared first on The Times of Israel.

item.title: Iran’s Ali Khamenei, who based brutal rule on fiery hostility to US and Israel, dead at 86
item.description: Surprisingly picked to lead Islamic Republic, supreme leader championed uranium enrichment during 36-year rule, built an army of terror proxies, and refused compromise to the bitter end The post Iran’s Ali Khamenei, who based brutal rule on fiery hostility to US and Israel, dead at 86 appeared first on The Times of Israel.

item.title: Sirens, shelters and an empty Old City: Jerusalem rattled on day 1 of war with Iran
item.description: Eerie silence settles over capital on Shabbat leading up to Purim holiday, as residents hunker down under ballistic missile fire and speculate about a conflict of biblical proportions The post Sirens, shelters and an empty Old City: Jerusalem rattled on day 1 of war with Iran appeared first on The Times of Israel.

item.title: US, Israel defend strikes on Iran as lawful at heated UN Security Council meeting
item.description: Islamic Republic's ambassador calls death of civilians amid joint attack a crime against humanity; US counterpart trades barbs over regime's mass killing of protesters last month The post US, Israel defend strikes on Iran as lawful at heated UN Security Council meeting appeared first on The Times of Israel.
